0022600001.text: Detroit opens its 2026-27 season at home against Boston, and both teams are still waiting to play their first game of the season. Boston will be without Devin Carter, who is out with an illness. The Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 104-103 win in Detroit on January 19, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Detroit a 50% chance to win.
